## Ventures & Software Systems
### Tathya (तथ्य) (VENTURE // EARLY RESEARCH · RESEARCH PHASE)
- Thesis: Research into how LLMs fail on non-standard Indian dialects (Punjabi, Haryanvi, Bhojpuri), and a verification layer to catch those failures.
- Problem: LLMs perform poorly on regional dialects due to token fragmentation.
- Status: Early research · eval set in progress
### Stratum (SAAS PLATFORM // SIMULATION · CONCEPT STAGE)
- Thesis: A live market simulation engine evaluating candidate decision speed and capital efficiency instead of static case studies.
- Problem: Hiring case studies are easily generated using LLMs without testing live judgment.
- Status: Concept and pitch stage · sandbox design in progress
### Flow State (DESKTOP OS // FOCUS · LOCAL BUILD)
- Thesis: A Python-backed offline focus desktop utility built to eliminate cloud telemetry leaks and context switching.
- Problem: Cloud telemetry leaks and context switching fragment developer focus.
- Status: Local build · Python + native OS webview & 16-bit math.sin audio
### Krama (क्रम) (SYSTEM UTILITY // ACADEMIC OS · STUDENT UTILITY)
- Thesis: An offline-first academic schedule optimization and attendance recovery calculus utility designed to eliminate surprise eligibility shortages below the mandatory 75% threshold.
- Problem: Mandatory attendance cutoffs (75%) trigger sudden academic disqualifications without proactive recovery visibility.
- Status: Student utility · offline-first recovery calculus
